# Pregnancy and Baby (Thailand)

> **One rule:** organise visits, rights and paperwork; never judge a symptom. Any danger sign below → **call 1669 or go to the hospital where she is booked (ห้องคลอด) now**, before anything else in the answer.

General information to help organise, not medical advice. The doctor or midwife decides tests, medicines and vaccines; this skill never suggests a medicine, supplement dose or "it is probably normal".

## Danger signs — hospital now, not the next visit

Bleeding from the vagina · water breaking or fluid leaking · the baby moving less than usual · severe headache, blurred vision, sudden swelling of face or hands · seizure (ชัก) · severe abdominal pain · high fever · vomiting that does not stop. Seizure, heavy bleeding or fainting → **1669**. (List from hospital patient leaflets; no Department of Health page found on the check date — รอยืนยัน the full list with the ANC clinic, but never wait to confirm in an emergency.)

| Situation | Use |

| Just found out, planning ANC visits, maternity pay and leave | this skill |
| Birth registration, newborn grant, baby vaccine calendar | this skill |

## 1 · Antenatal care (ฝากครรภ์)

- **Start before 12 weeks.** The Thai quality ANC guideline (กรมอนามัย 2565) sets **8 visits**; สปสช. pays for 8 (raised from 5 on 12 Aug 2569) and more when the doctor says so.
- Usual weeks: ≤12 · 20 · 26 · 30 · 34 · 36 · 38 · 40 (WHO 2016 pattern; no Thai page listed the weeks — รอยืนยัน with the clinic).
- Thai citizens under บัตรทอง get ANC free at the registered unit, including thalassaemia and Down syndrome screening; other schemes and ultrasound cover — ask (รอยืนยัน).
- Keep the pink book (สมุดบันทึกสุขภาพแม่และเด็ก) in the bag for every visit.

## 2 · Money and leave

| Right | Amount / rule | Status |
|---|---|---|
| ประกันสังคม มาตรา 33/39 childbirth lump sum | 15,000 บาท per birth, no limit on number; if both parents insured, one claims | confirmed |
| SSO maternity pay | 50% of average wage (wage base cap 17,500 from 1 Jan 2569, see scripts/check/facts.json) for 90 days; condition: 5 months' contributions in the 15 months before the birth month (รอยืนยัน: secondary sources disagree, no official page checked); form สปส. 2-01 + สูติบัตร | official page; รอยืนยัน whether days changed after the 2568 labour law |
| Maternity leave (พ.ร.บ.คุ้มครองแรงงาน ฉบับที่ 9 พ.ศ. 2568, in force 7 Dec 2568) | up to 120 days; employer pays up to 60 days; father 15 days' leave to help after birth | confirmed |
| SSO child allowance (สงเคราะห์บุตร) | 1,000 บาท/month per child, birth to 6 years, up to 3 children; 12 months' contributions in 36 months; since 1 Jan 2568 | confirmed (old sso.go.th page still says 400 — outdated) |
| มาตรา 40 | only plan 3 has child allowance; amount รอยืนยัน | รอยืนยัน |
| Newborn grant (เงินอุดหนุนเพื่อการเลี้ยงดูเด็กแรกเกิด) | 600 บาท/month to age 6, household income ≤ 100,000 บาท/person/year, forms ดร.01/ดร.02 at the อปท./เขต, check at csgcheck.dcy.go.th or the ทางรัฐ app | confirmed · making it universal from fiscal year 2570 was approved by the committee 14 Jul 2569 but no cabinet resolution found (รอยืนยัน) |

Typical pay in practice: employer 60 days full wage + SSO 50% for 90 days — ask HR how they overlap at your company.

## 3 · Birth registration (แจ้งเกิด)

- **Within 15 days** at the registrar where the baby was born (hospital births: the อำเภอ/เขต/เทศบาล of the hospital); another district is possible with the hospital certificate and 2 witnesses.
- Bring: hospital birth certificate (ท.ร.1/1), the house registration (เจ้าบ้าน copy) for the baby's address, ID cards of the parents and the person notifying.
- Late: the นายอำเภอ approves, fine up to 1,000 บาท.
- Then: add the baby to ทะเบียนบ้าน, claim SSO lump sum and child allowance, register the newborn grant, choose the health scheme.

## 4 · Baby vaccine calendar (EPI, free)

| Age | Vaccines |
|---|---|
| Birth | BCG · Hepatitis B (+1 month if the mother carries hepatitis B) |
| 2 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · IPV · Rotavirus |
| 4 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · IPV · Rotavirus |
| 6 months | DTP-HepB-Hib · OPV · Rotavirus |
| 9 months | MMR |
| 1 year | JE (live, LAJE) |
| 1.5 years | DTP · OPV · MMR |
| 2.5 years | LAJE |
| 4 years | DTP · OPV |
| ป.5 girls | HPV (number of doses changed recently — รอยืนยัน) |
| ป.6 | Td |

Source: WHO Thailand EPI factsheet 2024; the กรมควบคุมโรค PDF is an image only, so the table stays (รอยืนยัน) — **the pink book and the clinic's schedule win**. Optional (paid) vaccines: ask the paediatrician. Put each due date in the family calendar 7 days ahead.

## Worked example

Office worker, มาตรา 33, positive test at 7 weeks, due 20 Jun 2570. Plan: book first ANC this week (before 12 weeks) at the hospital where she will deliver; 8 visits into the calendar; pink book in the work bag. Money: 15,000 lump sum + SSO 50% for 90 days (wage base 17,500 → 8,750 a month) + employer 60 days full pay; check the SSO contribution count (needs 5 of the last 15 months). After birth: register at the เขต of the hospital within 15 days (by 5 Jul 2570), claim สปส. 2-01, child allowance 1,000/month, ask the เขต about the 600-baht grant. Vaccine calendar from the pink book.

## Check before sending

- [ ] Danger-sign line with 1669 is in the answer
- [ ] No symptom judged, no medicine or supplement suggested
- [ ] Every amount says its status; (รอยืนยัน) items are named to the user as not yet confirmed
- [ ] Dates are real dates in the user's calendar, not just "week 20"
